overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on improving reasoning capabilities through TOW data augmentation rather than traditional NLG evaluation. Most metrics and evaluations are focused on reasoning accuracy rather than text quality. The human evaluation is modest (200 examples) and focuses on failure mode analysis rather than comprehensive output quality assessment.
